purpose: Explain score-MSE versus actual move-choice mismatch on prior exposed evidence only

prior_leaf_reservoir.sampling_policy: Reservoir occurrences across all evaluated branches, not paired winning/refuting backed-up leaves

supported_findings: Point MSE improved without directly optimizing the argmax of backed-up competing root moves.
The actual-leaf data addition kept the earlier immediate-child pair files byte-identical.
Reservoir leaves cover many alternatives; a sample need not determine the root score or chosen move.
Printed native PV endpoints are not automatically the quiescence evaluator endpoint; no endpoint is used as a training label in this diagnosis.
Preservation permits nonzero output changes while limiting drift; root choice changes are sparse in the previously exposed gate.

recommended_controlled_change.loss: Keep point teacher MSE, pair-gap MSE, and old-training warm-output preservation MSE
recommended_controlled_change.pair_inputs: Use actual native evaluator calls that back up competing forced-root-move search scores, with full histories and legal endpoint witnesses
recommended_controlled_change.comparison_target: Teacher root-mover quality difference between the competing root moves; orient leaf scores consistently to white before loss
recommended_controlled_change.checks: Fixed-depth full-window TT-off completed search; reject bounds, terminal/draw-adjusted, missing static witness, and score/end-point mismatches; separate fresh gate before teacher queries
recommended_controlled_change.retained_guards: Current architecture, epoch-zero anchor limit, tuning-only checkpoint selection, early stopping, best restore, integer step acceptance, frozen fresh gate

limits: No causal contribution is assigned to preservation strength, teacher budget, or architecture from this single candidate.
Immediate-child margins do not prove an alternative root-search margin; forced-move backed-up leaf collection is needed for that comparison.
Teacher recommendation matches and centipawn deltas are finite-screen observations, not Elo or playing-strength proof.
